name: Building an AppSec Program
source: Building an AppSec Program/Building an AppSec Program - Interview Questions & Answers.md

prompts.title: How do you measure program success?
prompts.answerMarkdown: **A:** **MTTR** for High+, **Critical in prod** trend, **% Tier-1** with threat models, **scanner signal ratio**, **repeat finding rate**, developer satisfaction with consult SLAs.

prompts.title: Security champions—worth it?
prompts.answerMarkdown: **A:** Yes-**1 per squad** as force multiplier for triage, standards feedback, and local coaching; AppSec retains policy and deep reviews.

prompts.title: Build vs buy for tooling?
prompts.answerMarkdown:
**A:** Start with **platform defaults** (GitHub Advanced Security, cloud CSPM) plus **one** best-in-class per layer; expand when **signal** justifies cost.
